parameters.content: **Daily overdue reminders.** Every morning at 09:00 (instance timezone) ask Convex which approved loans are past their end date, email each borrower, then tell Convex the reminder went out. Convex ignores a repeated idempotency key, so a rerun never double counts.

parameters.jsCode:
const res = $input.first().json;
return (res.loans || []).map((loan) => ({ json: { ...loan, asOf: res.asOf } }));
